snippet.title: POLY TRUCK - WISHLIST - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Poly Truck is a fully physical, tactile truck simulator built from the ground up for standalone VR hardware. Players can step inside a highly interactive low-poly cockpit where every key turn, gear shift, and cabin control responds directly to your virtual hands. Master the realistic weight of your rig, navigate dynamic traffic, and conquer challenging routes across a stylized world. Wishlist Poly Truck now on the Meta Quest Horizon Store to lock in your spot for the ultimate standalone VR driving experience!
